title: Chorong Park Joins the University of Houston
summary: A new faculty appointment brings Park's research on aging, accessibility, and human-centered technology to the University of Houston.

sources.label: University of Houston: Preserve, Plan, Innovate (September 25, 2025)

paragraphs.text: Chorong Park announced on September 2, 2025, that she had joined the University of Houston as an Assistant Professor and Presidential Frontier Faculty member. The appointment begins a new chapter for her work at the intersection of human-computer interaction and aging.

The university's subsequent faculty introduction places Park in user experience and user interaction design within the Gerald D. Hines College of Architecture and Design. Her research connects aging and disability studies with accessible immersive experiences, AI agents, and social robotics.

Park brings doctoral training in technology, with a minor in gerontology, and a master's degree in UX design from Purdue University. The university profile emphasizes her participatory approach: developing technology with aging and disabled communities, with attention to accessibility, autonomy, and the experience of using it.
